Sam: Quick policy Q  I had to take an overnight sleeper train for a client meeting and paid  for a couchette upgrade so I could sleep and be fresh for the meeting. Can I expense the upgrade?
Aria (People Ops): Short answer: upgrades are only reimbursable with pre-approval unless theres a documented business need (e.g., overnight travel that would prevent you from being work-ready). For exceptions we need manager sign-off + receipts.
Sam: I didn't get pre-approval  but the meeting was early morning and there were no hotels available. I can attach the ticket + upgrade receipt and meeting invite.
Aria (People Ops): Please submit via Expensify and include: the original ticket, the upgrade receipt showing the extra charge, the meeting invite or calendar showing the early start, and a one-line justification in the expense comments explaining why hotel wasn't used. CC your manager in the submission. We'll route to Finance for manual review.
Ben (Manager): I saw Sam's calendar and approve the upgrade reimbursement for business readiness. Approving in comments now.
Finance-Bot: Reminder: category = Lodging/Travel -> "Transport upgrade (exception)". If documentation is thin finance may cap reimbursement to a reasonable allowance (coach fare + X). Use currency conversion from card statement or Expensify.
Sam: Uploaded ticket.pdf + upgrade_receipt.jpg + meeting invite. Added Ben's approval in the comments. Thanks.
Aria (People Ops): Thanks Sam  well fast-track this as an exception. For future overnight rail trips, please try to get pre-approval or check travel@redwood.com first. Closing once processed. :white_check_mark:
